GeneRoleClassifier — Multi-Scale 1D-CNN Training, Optuna Tuning & Validation

Curating non-redundant bacterial (taxonomy_id:2) and bacteriophage/prophage (taxonomy_id:10239) proteins across UniProtKB (Pfam/InterPro), UniRef50, NCBI IPG, and KEGG Orthology, deduplicating via [Clusterer][serogen.core.seq.clustering.Clusterer] (80% CD-HIT), and training [GeneRoleClassifier][serogen.genes.cnn.GeneRoleClassifier] across all 29 functional GeneRoles + a joint 1-bit bacterial/phage source head ([conv_max, conv_avg]).

1. Non-Redundant Reference Curation & Protein Length Profiles

All non-redundant sequences (<= 80% CD-HIT identity) per functional GeneRole are retained without artificial truncation caps, with proportional 80% / 20% stratified train/test splitting and 3.5 MAD length outlier filtering.

2. Optuna TPE Hyperparameter Optimization & Layer Representation Sweep

Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) search over multi-scale motif kernel widths, filter capacity, embedding dimension, and AdamW regularization, followed by a Numba-parallel representation sweep across all layers (best=penultimate).

4. Held-Out Test Performance & Row-Normalized Confusion Matrix

Per-role precision, recall, and F1-score alongside the 29×29 row-normalized confusion matrix on the stratified 20% holdout split.

5. Architectural Assessments, Dual-Head Weight Norms & Phage Source Analysis

Quantitative breakdown of Frobenius weight-norm allocation (||W||_F²) across the 29-role biosynthetic head (dense_w_) and the 1-bit bacterial vs. bacteriophage/prophage head (source_w_), plus ablation conclusions on the pure [conv_max, conv_avg] architecture.
